Code Editor · In development

Code editor

A code editor for your Files files. Nothing uploaded.

Open now

Code Editor has these main features: JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, JSON, Markdown and Python; Completion, search and replace, multiple cursors. It opens Plain text, Markdown, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JSON, Python, TypeScript.

In development: some features listed below may not be finished yet.

What you can do with Code Editor

  • Write HTML and run it in a preview
  • Format JSON
